value.rationale: For a well-motivated published vaccination-perception epidemic model, the result identifies an exact all-amplitude, all-regime balance law, a sharp structural threshold for compact interior recurrence and a quantitative impossibility of indefinitely sustained interior epidemics at/below threshold. The result applies without a singular time-scale assumption and is invariant under replacement of vaccine payoff evolution, giving useful dynamical constraints beyond known stationary equilibria.
